Gate-activation hypothesis

The gate activates on tokens indicating uncertainty, speculation, or lack of verification. This includes modal verbs like "may," "likely," "plausible," and phrases questioning the validity or source of information, such as "not supported," "false," or "no source."

Describes when the gate fires. It does not establish the transform’s causal output effect.
